name: Sei☆Inma ~Ijimete Inku-chan~
original_name: 聖☆淫魔 ～いじめてインクちゃん～
source:
Takahiro is a novice teacher. A demon suddenly appears before him saying that she's half angel and half demon and she does not qualify to enter either faction because of that. The strange cohabitation and rigorous training begins. Will she grow into an angel or a demon?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
貴弘是一名新手教師。一個惡魔突然出現在他面前，說自己是半天使半惡魔，因此沒有資格加入任何一方陣營。奇妙的同居生活和嚴苛的訓練就此開始。她究竟會成長為天使還是惡魔？

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
